# pinned-http-client

Install:

```
composer require rasuvaeff/pinned-http-client
```

## Rules

- PHP 8.3+, `declare(strict_types=1)`, needs `ext-curl`, `ext-filter`; Guzzle is used internally and never exposed
- Namespace `Rasuvaeff\PinnedHttpClient`
- `PinnedClient` is a PSR-18 client: resolves the host once (IPv4 + IPv6), checks EVERY address with an `AddressPolicy`, pins the connection to those addresses (`CURLOPT_RESOLVE`); a non-public address among public ones refuses the host
- The client builds its own transport: cURL handler only, no proxy from the environment, no redirects, body bounded (decompressed, default 10 MiB). It takes no Guzzle client, request options or cURL options
- Redirects: wrap it in `RedirectFollower` — every hop is resolved, checked and pinned again; 303 (and 301/302 for POST) → GET without body; credentials dropped on origin change; `maxRedirects` default 5
- Only http and https; a URL without host is refused; a literal IP is only checked
- Exceptions: abstract `ClientException` (`ClientExceptionInterface`, `getRequest()`): `RequestRefused` (`$reason`: `Refusal`), `TransferFailed` (`NetworkExceptionInterface`, cause in `getPrevious()`), `ResponseTooLarge` (`$limit`), `TooManyRedirects` (`$limit`)
- An explicit `proxy:` makes the proxy the SSRF boundary; DNS resolution has no client-side timeout

## API

```php
use GuzzleHttp\Psr7\Request;
use Rasuvaeff\PinnedHttpClient\{ClientException, PinnedClient, PublicAddresses, RedirectFollower, Refusal, RequestRefused, ResponseTooLarge, SystemResolver};

$client = new PinnedClient(
    policy: new PublicAddresses(),      // AddressPolicy::allows(string $address): bool
    resolver: new SystemResolver(),     // Resolver::resolve(string $host): list<string>
    timeoutSeconds: 8.0,                // > 0
    connectTimeoutSeconds: 4.0,         // > 0
    maxBodyBytes: PinnedClient::DEFAULT_MAX_BODY_BYTES, // >= 1 or null (no limit)
    proxy: null,                        // non-empty URL to opt in
);
$client->withMaxBodyBytes(65_536);      // new client
$client->withTimeouts(2.0, 1.0);        // new client

try {
    $response = (new RedirectFollower($client, maxRedirects: 5))->sendRequest(new Request('GET', $url));
} catch (RequestRefused $refused) {
    $refused->reason; // Refusal::UnsupportedScheme | MissingHost | Unresolvable | AddressNotAllowed
} catch (ResponseTooLarge $tooLarge) {
    $tooLarge->limit;
} catch (ClientException $failed) {
    // TransferFailed | TooManyRedirects
}

(new PublicAddresses())->allows('169.254.169.254'); // false
(new PublicAddresses())->allows('::ffff:10.0.0.1'); // false: judged as the embedded IPv4
(new PublicAddresses())->allows('93.184.216.34');   // true
```

`PublicAddresses` refuses: 0/8, 10/8, 100.64/10, 127/8, 169.254/16, 172.16/12, 192.0.0/24, 192.0.2/24, 192.88.99/24, 192.168/16,
198.18/15, 198.51.100/24, 203.0.113/24, 224/4, 240/4; IPv6 ::/96 (incl. :: and ::1), ::ffff:0:0:0/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48, 100::/64,
2001::/32, 2001:db8::/32, 2002::/16, 3fff::/20, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, fec0::/10, ff00::/8; `::ffff:a.b.c.d` and `64:ff9b::/96`
are judged by the embedded IPv4; non-IP text is refused.
